per_line.source_literal: The capacity increase reduced recorded source-context truncation warnings from 96 to3. The three remaining warnings correspond to malformed original Congregation captures; the audit did not establish that a larger arbitrary limit would recover their missing markup. On the final 603 run, the maximum fact count was 297 and the largest response was 222,009 UTF-8 bytes. The measured maximum source-fact **value** text was 165610 UTF-16 units; that metric excludes label/other budget contributions and must not be treated as the complete content-budget usage.
